programme.title: Wycliffe Gordon
programme.sub-title: Wynton Marsalis: In This House, on This Morning
programme.desc: The final concert of the Münchner Klaviersommer 1992 was by Wynton Marsalis and his septet. The 31-years-young star trumpeter performed one of his own jazz suites to the sold-out Philharmonie, under the title of ‘In This House, On This Morning'. The concert covers every jazz style, in composition and improvisation, and in both small and grand forms. Marsalis's Septet was made up of Wess Anderson (alto saxophone), Wycliffe Gordon (trombone), Reginald Veal (bass), Herlin Riley (drums), Todd Williams (tenor saxophone), and Eric Reed (piano).

programme.title: Dizzy Gillespie, Tony Coe, Derek Humble & Billy Mitchell
programme.desc: American jazz trumpeter, composer, and bandleader Dizzy Gillespie (1917-1993) was one of the seminal figures of the bebop movement. He fuses all musical forms rooted in African culture, such as music from Cuba, Latin America and the Caribbean, into his music. On November 4, 1970 he played a concert in Denmark with the Kenny Clarke/Francy Boland Big Band, performing Con Alma, Brother K, Now Hear My Meanin', Manteca, Let Me Outta Here, and Things Are Here.

programme.title: Chet Baker
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Count Basie
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1979, legendary big band leader and pianist Count Basie brought his famous big band to the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague to perform two sets. Basie, whose minimalist pianism and blues-oriented swing style had cemented his popularity as early as the 1930s, was in the midst of a European tour and had recorded his live album On the Road the previous night in Montreux, Switzerland. Here is the first of two sets recorded at the festival in 1979.

programme.title: Miles Davis
programme.desc: American trumpeter Miles Davis (1926-1991) was a pioneering jazz musician from the late 1940s to the late 1980s. His influence on 20th century music is hard to overstate, as he trailblazed bebop, cool jazz, hardbop, modal jazz, and electronic music. On October 11, 1964, Miles Davis performed at Teatro Dell'Arte in Milan. With tenor saxophonist Wayne Shorter, pianist Herbie Hancock, bassist Ron Carter and drummer Tony Williams, Davis performed Autumn Leaves, My Funny Valentine, All Blues, All of You, and Joshua.

programme.title: Alex Dee
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Count Basie
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1979, legendary big band leader and pianist Count Basie brought his famous big band to the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague to perform two sets. Basie, whose minimalist pianism and blues-oriented swing style had cemented his popularity as early as the 1930s, was in the midst of a European tour and had recorded his live album 'On the Road' the previous night in Montreux, Switzerland. Here is the second of two sets recorded at the festival in 1979.

programme.title: Duke Ellington
programme.sub-title: Duke Ellington: Jazz from Newport, Brussels, 1973
programme.desc: In 1956, Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed a legendary set at the third annual Newport Jazz Festival. It was tenor saxophonist Paul Gonsalves' outstanding 27-chorus solo on “Diminuendo and Crescendo in Blue” that revitalized Ellington's career. The success generated during that performance carried him for the rest of his life. By 1973, festivals carrying the Newport name were organized all over the world. Less than a year before his death, Ellington and his Orchestra, with Gonsalves still in the fold, appeared in Brussels to deliver a timeless performance before a highly appreciative crowd.

programme.title: Larry Graham
programme.sub-title: Larry Graham: Ultimate Funk at the Bataclan
programme.desc: This recording brings a great performance by Larry Graham & Graham Central Station from Bataclan in Paris. Numerous ‘funkateers' came together to cheer the bass player and funk hero. In the sixties, Graham was mainly known for his work with Sly and the Family Stone, the popular and influential psychedelic soul and funk band. As founder and front man of Graham Central Station he has also enjoyed a successful solo career. It is often said that Graham pioneered the art of slap-pop playing on the electric bass, which has become a staple of modern funk. During this Paris performance, Graham shows he is one of the heroes of funk!

programme.title: Ana María Paño-Osorio & Philharmonie de Paris
programme.sub-title: Sinfonía por el Perú from Philharmonie de Paris
programme.desc: Superstar tenor Juan Diego Flórez brings to life the most iconic roles of the bel canto repertoire, joined by the vibrant young musicians of Sinfonía por el Perú, led by the celebrated conductor Ana María Patiño-Osorio! Embark on a lyrical adventure with them, from the powerful drama of Bellini's I Capuleti e I Montecchi and the majestic Jerusalem by Verdi, to the boisterous and spirited cancan of Offenbach's operetta Orpheus in the Underworld. Sinfonía por el Perú is a nonprofit organization founded by Juan Diego Flórez, with a mission to inspire social change through collective music education. Since its inception in 2011, over six thousand young Peruvians have embraced the opportunity to play an instrument or sing in a choir. Students from the program have graced the world's most prestigious stages, from Salzburg to Gstaad, including the Lucerne Festival, and they accompany Juan Diego Flórez for this concert.

programme.title: Gianandrea Noseda, London Symphony Orchestra, Chris Richards & Rachel Gough
programme.sub-title: Gianandrea Noseda conducts Strauss and Liszt
programme.desc: Gianandrea Noseda conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a concert performance recorded on April 15, 2021, at St. Luke's, London. The program begins with Richard Strauss's Duett-Concertino for clarinet and bassoon, a late, lyrical work that evokes a fairy-tale-like dialogue between the two solo instruments, featuring Chris Richards (clarinet) and Rachel Gough (bassoon). Next is Franz Liszt's Symphonic Poem No. 4, Orpheus, a contemplative and radiant homage to the mythic musician. The concert concludes with Nino Rota's Symphony No. 3, a richly melodic and rhythmically vibrant work that reflects the cinematic flair for which the composer is widely known.

programme.title: Rodolfo Mederos, Otros Aires, Teresa Parodi & Café de los Maestros
programme.desc: For the audience in the famous ballroom El Palacio in Buenos Aires, the year 2012 began with tango rhythms and Argentinean folk music. This festive broadcast opens with a tango performance by dance partners Eduardo and Gloria, accompanied by the renowned ensemble Café de los Maestros. Another highlights is a performance by bandoneon player Rodolfo Mederos and his trio. In addition, the concert features a performance by Teresa Parodi, former lead singer of the Astor Piazzolla Band, accompanied by the Fernando Suárez Paz Quintet. Also on the bill is the contemporary electronic tango formation Otros Aires. Founded by Miguel Di Genova in 2003, Otros Aires combines electronic rhythms and traditional tango instruments, such as the bandoneon, piano, and guitar. On the program are compositions by Astor Piazzolla, Pedro Maffia, Pedro Laurenz, Gustavo Mozzi, and many others. Enjoy this concert of music and dance, featuring some of Argentine's tango scene's finest artists!

programme.title: Gewandhausorchester Leipzig, Andris Nelsons & Kristine Opolais
programme.desc: Andris Nelsons, together with his then-wife, the great soprano Kristine Opolais and the Gewandhausorchester Leipzig present a program dedicated to Antonin Dvořák, singing the melodies that the composer hid in all layers of his music with tender, warm, soft colors. Nelsons' tempos remain calm and relaxed, allowing the omnipresent beauty of Dvořák's music to unfold and flood the Gewandhaus. The program opens with Othello, a Concert Overture for Orchestra, Op. 93. Opolais performs “Song to the Moon” from Rusalka, “Songs my Mother Taught Me” from Gypsy Songs, Op. 55/4. This is followed by the Polonaise and 'O, marno, marno to je' from Rusalka and 'Dobrá! Já mu je dám!... Jak je mi?' from Smetana's opera Dalibor. The concert closes with a performance of Dvořák's Symphony no. 9 in E Minor, Op. 95 (“From the New World”). Recorded at the Gewandhaus, Leipzig in May 2017.

programme.title: Zulu (1964)
programme.desc: Outnumbered British soldiers do battle with Zulu warriors at Rorke's Drift.

programme.title: Sky Kids
programme.desc: As a pair of schoolboys sneak a look around an empty private aircraft, two criminals take off with the kids still inside. Upon discovering the men are dangerous gangsters, the horrified lads inadvertently become embroiled in the mobsters's scheme.

programme.title: Snitch (2013)
programme.desc: A father (Dwayne Johnson) goes undercover for the DEA in order to free his son who was imprisoned after being set up in a drug deal.

programme.title: Push
programme.desc: Superhumans defy a government plot to harness and abuse their powers. Chris Evans and Dakota Fanning (the TWILIGHT films) team in a pulse-pounding paranormal thriller.

programme.title: Runaway Jury
programme.desc: In this suspenseful thriller, a high-priced and ruthless jury "consultant" will stop at nothing to secure a verdict on an explosive trial.

programme.title: The Expendables 3
programme.desc: Barney augments his team with new blood to take down Conrad Stonebanks, the Expendables co-founder.

programme.title: Escape Plan
programme.desc: The world's authority on structural security accepts a job to break out of an ultra-secret, high-tech facility

programme.title: The Expendables
programme.desc: A CIA operative hires a team of mercenaries to eliminate a Latin dictator and a renegade CIA agent.

programme.title: Queen of the Desert
programme.desc: A chronicle of Gertrude Bell's life, a traveler, writer, archaeologist, explorer, cartographer, and political attach for the British Empire at the dawn of the twentieth century.

programme.title: Love N' Dancing
programme.desc: Jessica (Amy Smart) had given up on her dream of a life of the stage, until she meets ex-dance champion Jake (Tom Malloy), who becomes her teacher when the couple make an instant connection. Together, they decide to risk it all when they enter the World Swing Championship to reclaim Jake's former title.

programme.title: G-Loc
programme.desc: In a world on the brink of environmental collapse, mass migration to neighbouring planet, Rhea, is humanity's final hope for survival. The only problem is, in the sixteen Earth years since the first humans landed on Rhea, two hundred and eighty-eight years have passed on the new planet and the existing population are no longer welcoming new arrivals, with the Rheans having set up a space blockade to shot down any ship that tries to cross into their territory. 'Earther', Bran, has big dreams of a better life in this new world, but the odds are stacked against him. Finding himself the lone survivor of a failed emigration attempt, his escape pod floats mindlessly in space and his oxygen is running low. His only chance of survival is to hook up to a rogue Rhean supply ship called The Nysa running on auxiliary power. But after finding the crew on board The Nysa dead, it seems Bran may have more than just a hostile planet to worry about. An intense interstellar thriller with an impressive cast, including Stephen Moyer (True Blood), Casper Van Dien (Starship Troopers) and John Rhys-Davies (the Indiana Jones and Lord of the Rings franchises).

programme.title: Me, Myself and Di
programme.desc: After winning the 'trip of a lifetime' to a caravan park in Rhyl, North Wales, unlucky in love Northerner, Janet Brown, is ready for a holiday romance. Unfortunately, following the advice of best friend Diana (Lucy Pinder) - that Janet should pretend to be the opposite of who she actually is in order to find love - doesn't quite lead to the happily ever after she was hoping for. A laugh-out-loud gritty rom-com with a huge ensemble cast including James Lance (Northern Soul, Bronson, Marie Antoinette, Bel Ami), Will Mellor (Two Pints of Lager and a Packet of Crisps, Line of Duty), Larry Lamb (EastEnders, The Hatton Garden Job), Marek Oravec (Captain America: The First Avenger), Wim Snape (The Full Monty, Coronation Street), and Katy Clayton (Casualty, Shameless).

programme.title: The Confirmation
programme.desc: Heart-warming and hilarious, this family tale stars Academy Award nominee Clive Owen (Children of Men) and Maria Bello (A History of Violence). Walt, a down-on-his luck carpenter, is tasked with entertaining his eight-year-old son Anthony. But when Walt's prized toolbox is stolen, a quiet father-and-son weekend turns into an adventure of a lifetime. This sincere story of fatherhood is a must see!

programme.title: Witch Hunt
programme.desc: Hunted. Persecuted. Executed. The witch trials come to life in modern day America. Claire (Gideon Adlon - The Craft: Legacy) and her mother (Elizabeth Mitchell - The Expanse) are part of an underground movement that ferries women accused of witchcraft to safety. All is well until a new charge brings the witch hunters to their door. Will they also be charged with the ungodly crime of being a witch?

programme.title: Mickey and the Bear
programme.desc: A powerful and heartfelt coming-of-age story, starring Camila Morrone (Death Wish) and James Badge Dale (13 Hours). Mickey is torn between the freedom she craves and the love she has for her father. As a toxic relationship with her addict father forms and in a desperate search for independence and her own identity, she risks family, heartbreak, and her standing in the only place she can call home.

programme.title: Fortress (2022)
programme.desc: An all-out-action cyber thriller starring action legend Bruce Willis, Jesse Metcalfe (Escape Plan II) and Chad Michael Murray (One Tree Hill). Robert is a retired CIA agent living at a secret resort. When his estranged son visits, he is followed by Robert's old nemesis, Balzary. Under attack, they retreat to a high-tech bunker. But is it powerful enough to match Balzary's bloodthirsty revenge?

programme.title: After The Wedding
programme.desc: Isabel (Michelle Williams) has devoted her life to running an orphanage in a Kolkata slum. With funds running dry, she lands uncomfortably in the sights of a possible benefactor, Theresa Young (Julianne Moore), a multi-millionaire media mogul. Theresa's life couldn't appear to be more perfect.

programme.title: On a Wing and a Prayer
programme.desc: In this extraordinary true story of faith and survival, "On A Wing and A Prayer" follows passenger Doug White's (Dennis Quaid) harrowing journey to safely land a plane and save his entire family from insurmountable danger after their pilot dies unexpectedly mid-flight. Heather Graham also stars.

programme.title: Alone In Berlin
programme.desc: Alone in Berlin sees a couple in Nazi Germany stand up to Hitler and the SS regime after their son is killed in action. By placing postcards around Berlin with revolutionary messages on, the Quangel's hope to rally other anti-Hitler supporters, and disrupt the slow creep of war.

programme.title: The Confirmation
programme.desc: A divorced father and his eight-year-old son, spend a rather predictable weekend together, but when a valuable toolbox gets stolen, the search for the thieves will turn into a true family bonding.

programme.title: Sister Dating Swap
programme.desc: (2023) Romantic comedy starring Lauren Collins. Two sisters swap homes for two weeks to escape their routines, only to find that love and self-discovery are just a change of address away.​

programme.title: The Blessing Bracelet
programme.desc: (2023) Uplifting drama starring Amanda Schull and Carlo Marks. When a struggling single mother rediscovers a bracelet she made as a teenager, will she find that a little belief goes a long way?

programme.title: Her Pen Pal
programme.desc: Victoria is in Paris for friend's wedding, but she needs a date to make her ex believe she's over him, will Jacques her childhood French pen pal assist her in this ruse? (2021)

programme.title: Bottled With Love
programme.desc: Unlucky in love Abbey opens her heart in a letter and puts it in a bottle and toss it out to sea. Months later, a man fishing discovers it and opts to reach out. Starring Bethany Joy Lenz (2019)

programme.title: Valentine Ever After
programme.desc: Keen to escape the big city, Julia and Sydney head to Wyoming for a fun getaway. However, the trip sees Julia re-evaluate her life choices, including her career and the man she truly loves. (2016)

programme.title: Aristotle and Dante

Will he reveal what he knows if it risks his growing relationship--and mutual love--with Lily?

programme.title: Spotlight [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 2001, editor Marty Baron of The Boston Globe assigns a team of journalists to investigate allegations against John Geoghan, an unfrocked priest accused of molesting more than 80 boys. Led by editor Walter "Robby" Robinson (Michael Keaton), reporters Michael Rezendes (Mark Ruffalo), Matt Carroll and Sacha Pfeiffer interview victims and try to unseal sensitive documents. The reporters make it their mission to provide proof of a cover-up of sexual abuse within the Roman Catholic Church.

programme.title: A Little Trip to Heaven
programme.desc: Insurance investigator Abraham Holt travels to a tiny town in rural Minnesota to look into a particularly unusual insurance claim stemming from a horrific car accident. As Holt examines the scene of the wreck, it all seems a bit too perfect. And when he interviews Isolde McBride and her shifty husband, Fred -- the impoverished beneficiaries of the massive, recently initiated life-insurance policy -- he begins to suspect that something is amiss.

programme.title: Animal Factory [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Suburbanite Ron (Edward Furlong) is spoiled, young and not overly worried about the marijuana charges leveled against him. But, after being made out to be a drug dealer, he faces a five-year jail sentence in San Quentin State Prison. Physically frail and unaccustomed to his rough surroundings, Ron is primed to fall victim to sexual predators and bullying guards -- that is, until he's befriended by Earl (Willem Dafoe), a veteran inmate who finds meaning in protecting the vulnerable new kid.

programme.title: 13 Moons [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A man (Steve Buscemi) employed as a clown and his sidekick (Peter Dinklage) try to find a kidney donor for the son of a bail bondsman (David Proval).

programme.title: Children of the Corn
programme.desc: As physician Burt Stanton (Peter Horton) and his girlfriend, Vicky (Linda Hamilton), drive across the Midwest to his new job, their trip comes to a sudden halt when they encounter the body of a murdered boy in the road. In trying to contact the authorities, Burt and Vicky wander into a small town populated only by children, followers of sinister young preacher Isaac Chroner (John Franklin). Soon the couple is fleeing the youthful fanatics, who want to sacrifice them to their demonic deity.

programme.title: Derailed [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Secret agent Kristoff (Jean-Claude Van Damme) is assigned to escort Galina Konstantin (Laura Elena Harring), a thief in possession of a deadly virus, on a train journey that unluckily falls on his birthday. Kristoff tells his disappointed wife, son and daughter that he's taking a business trip. They decide to sneak aboard the train as a surprise, only to suspect he's having an affair with the mysterious Galina. To make matters much worse, terrorists hijack the train and go after the virus.

programme.title: K-19: The Widowmaker
programme.desc: Follows Captain Alexei Vostrikov who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men.

programme.title: A Tale Of Two Guns
programme.desc: In the lawless West, The Cowboys a notorious brotherhood of killers and thieves reigned over the land with brutal fists and fast guns. Fate had finally caught up with them - and now the merciless gang has but a single surviving member. When a deputized gunslinger takes up the call to hunt down the last Cowboy, the chase is on and the bullets fly and only one of these hardened men can survive.

programme.title: The Blackout: Invasion Earth
programme.desc: An unexplained phenomenon has struck the Earth. Contact between most towns on Earth has been severed. A small area in Eastern Europe is the only location that still has electricity. When military forces venture outside, they discover a shocking truth - corpses everywhere. In stores, in cars, on roads, in hospitals and railway stations. Who or what is destroying all life on Earth? And how long can the last outpost of mankind endure?

programme.title: Mes chers voisins...
programme.desc: Après avoir été violemment agressés, de futurs parents quittent la ville pour la campagne idyllique afin d'y élever leur enfant.

programme.title: Mission bébé
programme.desc: Les meilleurs amis d'un couple marié doivent collaborer pour s'occuper du bébé du couple et organiser son premier anniversaire.

programme.title: Mon passé volé
programme.desc: Mallory a partiellement perdu la mémoire suite à plusieurs accidents. Elle retrouve peu à peu ses souvenirs et découvre une vérité sordide.

programme.title: Deux chefs et un gâteau de mariage
programme.desc: Une critique gastronomique au sommet de son art doit faire la paix avec un chef allergique aux critiques avant le mariage de sa soeur.

programme.title: The Trouble With Angels
programme.desc: A pair of troublemakers wreak havoc on a convent school.

programme.title: Fail Safe
programme.desc: American planes are sent to deliver a nuclear attack on Moscow, but it's a mistake due to a malfunction.

programme.title: Murderers' Row
programme.desc: Matt Helm rescues the kidnapped inventor of an ultra-destructive "helio beam" capable of destroying a city.

programme.title: Monty Python and the Holy Grail
programme.desc: A comedic send-up of the grim circumstances of the Middle Ages as told through the story of King Arthur and framed by a modern-day murder investigation. When the mythical king of the Britons leads his knights on a quest for the Holy Grail, they face a wide array of horrors, including a persistent Black Knight, a three-headed giant, a cadre of shrubbery-challenged knights, the perilous Castle Anthrax, a killer rabbit, a house of virgins, and a handful of rude Frenchmen.

programme.title: Find Me Guilty
programme.desc: Imprisoned on a drug charge, mobster Jack DiNorscio refuses to testify against his former associates in the Lucchesi crime family. When an ambitious prosecutor brings him back to court, he decides to defend himself. Initially regarded with disbelief, his forceful presence and knowledge of the law turn the tide of the trial.

programme.desc: Determined to help at-risk youths avoid the mistakes he made, an ex-con (Cuba Gooding Jr.) forms a chess club to offer them an alternative to running with street gangs.

Unfortunately for Kyle, he is assigned to a prison that is renowned for its violence. Controlled by a corrupt and sadistic warden, the facility regularly holds brutal fights between inmates. In order to survive in the prison, Kyle must participate in the battles, even as he attempts to retain his humanity.

programme.title: The Rifleman

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Two prison wagon drivers stop at the McCain ranch looking for whiskey. Lucas turns them down because they are escorting a murderer, to be hanged in Yuma.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Mark goes to work for Will Temple, a badly scarred, very mysterious rancher.

programme.title: The Rifleman

programme.title: Wycliffe Gordon
programme.sub-title: Wynton Marsalis: In This House, on This Morning
programme.desc: The final concert of the Münchner Klaviersommer 1992 was by Wynton Marsalis and his septet. The 31-years-young star trumpeter performed one of his own jazz suites to the sold-out Philharmonie, under the title of ‘In This House, On This Morning'. The concert covers every jazz style, in composition and improvisation, and in both small and grand forms. Marsalis's Septet was made up of Wess Anderson (alto saxophone), Wycliffe Gordon (trombone), Reginald Veal (bass), Herlin Riley (drums), Todd Williams (tenor saxophone), and Eric Reed (piano).

programme.title: Dizzy Gillespie, Tony Coe, Derek Humble & Billy Mitchell
programme.desc: American jazz trumpeter, composer, and bandleader Dizzy Gillespie (1917-1993) was one of the seminal figures of the bebop movement. He fuses all musical forms rooted in African culture, such as music from Cuba, Latin America and the Caribbean, into his music. On November 4, 1970 he played a concert in Denmark with the Kenny Clarke/Francy Boland Big Band, performing Con Alma, Brother K, Now Hear My Meanin', Manteca, Let Me Outta Here, and Things Are Here.

programme.title: Chet Baker
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Count Basie
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1979, legendary big band leader and pianist Count Basie brought his famous big band to the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague to perform two sets. Basie, whose minimalist pianism and blues-oriented swing style had cemented his popularity as early as the 1930s, was in the midst of a European tour and had recorded his live album On the Road the previous night in Montreux, Switzerland. Here is the first of two sets recorded at the festival in 1979.

programme.title: Miles Davis
programme.desc: American trumpeter Miles Davis (1926-1991) was a pioneering jazz musician from the late 1940s to the late 1980s. His influence on 20th century music is hard to overstate, as he trailblazed bebop, cool jazz, hardbop, modal jazz, and electronic music. On October 11, 1964, Miles Davis performed at Teatro Dell'Arte in Milan. With tenor saxophonist Wayne Shorter, pianist Herbie Hancock, bassist Ron Carter and drummer Tony Williams, Davis performed Autumn Leaves, My Funny Valentine, All Blues, All of You, and Joshua.

Here is the second of two sets recorded at the festival in 1979.

programme.title: Duke Ellington
programme.sub-title: Duke Ellington: Jazz from Newport, Brussels, 1973
programme.desc: In 1956, Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed a legendary set at the third annual Newport Jazz Festival. It was tenor saxophonist Paul Gonsalves' outstanding 27-chorus solo on “Diminuendo and Crescendo in Blue” that revitalized Ellington's career. The success generated during that performance carried him for the rest of his life. By 1973, festivals carrying the Newport name were organized all over the world. Less than a year before his death, Ellington and his Orchestra, with Gonsalves still in the fold, appeared in Brussels to deliver a timeless performance before a highly appreciative crowd.

programme.title: Larry Graham
programme.sub-title: Larry Graham: Ultimate Funk at the Bataclan
programme.desc: This recording brings a great performance by Larry Graham & Graham Central Station from Bataclan in Paris. Numerous ‘funkateers' came together to cheer the bass player and funk hero. In the sixties, Graham was mainly known for his work with Sly and the Family Stone, the popular and influential psychedelic soul and funk band. As founder and front man of Graham Central Station he has also enjoyed a successful solo career. It is often said that Graham pioneered the art of slap-pop playing on the electric bass, which has become a staple of modern funk. During this Paris performance, Graham shows he is one of the heroes of funk!

programme.title: Ana María Paño-Osorio & Philharmonie de Paris
programme.sub-title: Sinfonía por el Perú from Philharmonie de Paris
programme.desc: Superstar tenor Juan Diego Flórez brings to life the most iconic roles of the bel canto repertoire, joined by the vibrant young musicians of Sinfonía por el Perú, led by the celebrated conductor Ana María Patiño-Osorio! Embark on a lyrical adventure with them, from the powerful drama of Bellini's I Capuleti e I Montecchi and the majestic Jerusalem by Verdi, to the boisterous and spirited cancan of Offenbach's operetta Orpheus in the Underworld. Sinfonía por el Perú is a nonprofit organization founded by Juan Diego Flórez, with a mission to inspire social change through collective music education. Since its inception in 2011, over six thousand young Peruvians have embraced the opportunity to play an instrument or sing in a choir. Students from the program have graced the world's most prestigious stages, from Salzburg to Gstaad, including the Lucerne Festival, and they accompany Juan Diego Flórez for this concert.

programme.title: Gianandrea Noseda, London Symphony Orchestra, Chris Richards & Rachel Gough
programme.sub-title: Gianandrea Noseda conducts Strauss and Liszt
programme.desc: Gianandrea Noseda conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a concert performance recorded on April 15, 2021, at St. Luke's, London. The program begins with Richard Strauss's Duett-Concertino for clarinet and bassoon, a late, lyrical work that evokes a fairy-tale-like dialogue between the two solo instruments, featuring Chris Richards (clarinet) and Rachel Gough (bassoon). Next is Franz Liszt's Symphonic Poem No. 4, Orpheus, a contemplative and radiant homage to the mythic musician. The concert concludes with Nino Rota's Symphony No. 3, a richly melodic and rhythmically vibrant work that reflects the cinematic flair for which the composer is widely known.

programme.title: Rodolfo Mederos, Otros Aires, Teresa Parodi & Café de los Maestros
programme.desc: For the audience in the famous ballroom El Palacio in Buenos Aires, the year 2012 began with tango rhythms and Argentinean folk music. This festive broadcast opens with a tango performance by dance partners Eduardo and Gloria, accompanied by the renowned ensemble Café de los Maestros. Another highlights is a performance by bandoneon player Rodolfo Mederos and his trio. In addition, the concert features a performance by Teresa Parodi, former lead singer of the Astor Piazzolla Band, accompanied by the Fernando Suárez Paz Quintet. Also on the bill is the contemporary electronic tango formation Otros Aires. Founded by Miguel Di Genova in 2003, Otros Aires combines electronic rhythms and traditional tango instruments, such as the bandoneon, piano, and guitar. On the program are compositions by Astor Piazzolla, Pedro Maffia, Pedro Laurenz, Gustavo Mozzi, and many others. Enjoy this concert of music and dance, featuring some of Argentine's tango scene's finest artists!

programme.title: Gewandhausorchester Leipzig, Andris Nelsons & Kristine Opolais
programme.desc: Andris Nelsons, together with his then-wife, the great soprano Kristine Opolais and the Gewandhausorchester Leipzig present a program dedicated to Antonin Dvořák, singing the melodies that the composer hid in all layers of his music with tender, warm, soft colors. Nelsons' tempos remain calm and relaxed, allowing the omnipresent beauty of Dvořák's music to unfold and flood the Gewandhaus. The program opens with Othello, a Concert Overture for Orchestra, Op. 93. Opolais performs “Song to the Moon” from Rusalka, “Songs my Mother Taught Me” from Gypsy Songs, Op. 55/4. This is followed by the Polonaise and 'O, marno, marno to je' from Rusalka and 'Dobrá! Já mu je dám!... Jak je mi?' from Smetana's opera Dalibor. The concert closes with a performance of Dvořák's Symphony no. 9 in E Minor, Op. 95 (“From the New World”). Recorded at the Gewandhaus, Leipzig in May 2017.

programme.title: Ben Harper and Relentless7
programme.desc: The California native is a natural born showman, a slide-guitar legend whose ability to dabble in (and pull off) everything from folk blues to country jazz and reggae has earned Harper legions of fans the world over. So when we were given the opportunity to film Ben Harper accompanied by the blues-driven Texas trio Relentless7 at the Metro in Sydney, needless to say we were a little bit excited. And it may have been filmed in 2009, but this show was such a stand out favorite of ours there was no question that it was set to become one of our Classic Concerts someday.

programme.title: Yo, gran cazador
programme.desc: Tras el asesinato de su mentor por parte de los indios, Pike decide vengarse y emprende la búsqueda del asesino que mató a su compañero. Pero en su camino se cruza un majestuoso caballo blanco.

programme.title: Persona

Una enfermera, Alma, se encarga de cuidarla en una solitaria casita junto al mar. El silencio de Elisabet contrasta con las confesiones íntimas de Alma. Entre las dos mujeres se establece una relación singular, inexplicable.

programme.title: Grandes almacenes
programme.desc: Bruno y Lauretta trabajan en unos grandes almacenes. Bruno está enamorado de Lauretta, pero ella le evita.

programme.title: Las colinas tienen ojos II
programme.desc: Varios años después de la matanza de las montañas, Bobby, uno de los pocos supervivientes, se ha casado con Ruby. Juntos dirigen un equipo de motocross y organizan un viaje en autobús para competir en una carrera.

programme.title: Adiós a las armas
programme.desc: El conductor de una ambulancia estadounidense y una enfermera inglesa se enamoran en Italia durante la Primera Guerra Mundial.

programme.title: El gran McLintock
programme.desc: Un adinerado ranchero esa su poder e influencia en el territorio para mantener la paz entre granjeros, rancheros, nativos americanos y funcionarios corruptos.

programme.title: Mi pie izquierdo
programme.desc: Ganadora de Oscars (1989): Mejor Actor y Actriz secundaria. Basada en la biografía de Christy Brown. Aquejado de parálisis cerebral, gracias a su tenacidad y al incondicional apoyo de su madre, consiguió su integración en la sociedad.

programme.title: Siempre a tu lado Hachiko
programme.desc: Basada en una historia real, la película narra la historia de amistad entre un profesor universitario y Hachi, el perro de Akita. Hachi, símbolo de la lealtad y la amistad, esperará en la estación pacientemente a un dueño que puede que no vuelva nunca.

programme.title: Mercenarios de élite
programme.desc: Mercenarios protegen tecnología mortal y rescatan a la hija de un CEO secuestrada por terroristas.

programme.title: El Último Guerrero
programme.desc: Son tiempos en que una civilización está reemplazando a otra. Está por comenzar una nueva era.

programme.title: Los Ultimos Dias del Che
programme.desc: Reconstruyendo la campaña final del Che al seguir su viaje boliviano y su legado perdurable.

programme.title: Imparable
programme.desc: Un exgánster intenta vivir en paz, pero tras el secuestro de su esposa, retoma la violencia para salvarla.

programme.title: El Forastero (The Outsider)
programme.desc: Montana, finales del siglo XIX. El poderoso ganadero Fergus Hunter hace y deshace a su antojo en el condado. Decidido a comprar las tierras de unos colonos Amish pasará de la extorsión al asesinato.

programme.title: La Perfecta Desconocida
programme.desc: Mientras un hombre contempla mudarse a un nuevo estado con su esposa para su programa de posgrado, un viejo amor, una mujer que a menudo cambia de identidad, regresa a su vida en una cena de cumpleaños.

programme.title: El sueño de una noche de verano
programme.desc: Enamórate. Diviértete. Comienza una noche mágica... Un reparto estelar en una maravillosa comedia llena de descabelladas pasiones, peligrosas pociones y espíritus traviesos.

programme.title: Contra
programme.desc: El profesor Richard Pohl se hace viral tras un comentario xenófobo en clase: insulta a Naima Hamid, estudiante de Derecho, delante de todos sus compañeros.

programme.title: Fuera de la oscuridad
programme.desc: Secuela que sigue a la familia Skov desde 1943 hasta el final de la Segunda Guerra Mundial. La creciente oposición a la ocupación y la creciente brutalidad de los nazis tienen consecuencias fatales para la familia.

programme.title: Una historia real
programme.desc: Cuando el desafortunado reportero del NY Times, Michael Finkel (Jonah Hill) conoce a Christian Longo (James Franco) –el cual ha robado su identidad– su investigación se convierte en una tensa persecución entre ratón y gato.

programme.title: Bravetown
programme.desc: Josh es un alma sin rumbo con un talento musical extraordinario que se embarca en un viaje para encontrar lo que menos esperaba, pero que, sin duda alguna, más necesitaba.

programme.title: Evelyn
programme.desc: Basada en una historia real, narra como en la Irlanda de los años cincuenta la pequeña Evelyn y sus dos hermanos son separados y enviados a distintos orfanatos católicos, cuando un tribunal decide que su padre es incapaz de cuidar de ellos.

programme.title: Nunca Es Tarde Para Enamorarse
programme.desc: Harvey, un hombre que acaba de quedarse sin trabajo, viaja a Londres para asistir a la boda de su hija.

programme.title: El problema con el muérdago
programme.desc: Reencuentro con un primer amor: el reto de no caer dos veces.

programme.title: Tercera identidad
programme.desc: Sally está casada con un inglés que lleva una doble vida: es periodista y agente del KGB.

programme.title: Amor Sin Tiempo
programme.desc: Megan parece tener la vida perfecta: una relación amorosa con un maravilloso esposo y dos adorables hijos.

programme.title: París puede esperar
programme.desc: Coqueta y encantadora comedia romántica. La vida de Anne (Diane Lane) se encuentra en una encrucijada. Casada desde hace muchos años con un exitoso productor de Hollywood (Alec Baldwin) adicto al trabajo, emprende un inesperado viaje por la campiña francesa con el encantador socio de su marido.

programme.title: Una pizca de amor
programme.desc: En un impulso, Zoey alquila un camión de comida y participa en un "reality" de TV. La temperatura sube entre ella y el guapo fundador de una cadena de comida rápida, pero cuando descubre que es uno de los jueces del concurso, las cosas se enfrían.

programme.title: Nunca es tarde para enamorarse
programme.desc: En Londres para la boda de su hija, Harvey (Dustin Hoffman), un hombre arruinado encuentra su espíritu romántico levantado por una nueva mujer en su vida.

programme.title: Amor en pleno vuelo
programme.desc: Cuando Lily Summers vuelve a su ciudad para ayudar a su tía Maggie a llevar su hostal junto al puerto deportivo, conoce a Marcus, un guapo piloto de hidroaviones cuyo trabajo y vocación entregando perros de rescate ayuda a Lily a descubrir que el hogar está donde está el corazón.

programme.title: El rostro de un ángel
programme.desc: Una periodista y un director de documentales investigan un crimen cometido en Perugia (Italia). La protagonista es Amanda Knox, la estudiante norteamericana que fue acusada de asesinar a una compañera de piso con la complicidad de su novio italiano y un amigo de Costa de Marfil.

programme.title: El desayuno de los campeones
programme.desc: Retrato de una ciudad del medio-oeste americano que es el hogar de un grupo de personas con su propia idiosincrasia y un poco neuróticos. Dwayne Hoover es el dueño de un concesionario de coches que está al borde del suicidio y está perdiendo el contacto con la realidad.

programme.title: El hombre perfecto
programme.desc: Mathieu, de 25 años, siempre ha aspirado a convertirse en un autor reconocido. Un sueño que parece inalcanzable para él, porque…

programme.title: Los secretos del corazón
programme.desc: Becca y Howie Corbett luchan para volver a la normalidad después de que un giro del destino en forma de súbita y terrible pérdida haya sumido sus vidas en el caos. Atrapados en un laberinto de culpa, recriminación, sarcasmo y rabia, la pareja se enfrenta a la situación de formas distintas, haciendo elecciones que amenazan seriamente con distanciarlos. Pero a medida que se desarrollan los acontecimientos y sus vidas cobran nuevos significados, deben encontrar un punto en común que les permita seguir juntos...

programme.title: Amanece en Edimburgo
programme.desc: Dos soldados regresan a su casa en Edimburgo para reanudar su vida romántica y familiar.

programme.title: El Furgón
programme.desc: A consecuencia de un accidente de tráfico, tres delincuentes escapan del furgón policial.

programme.title: Memoria Perdida
programme.desc: Tras sufrir un golpe en la cabeza, un periodista de Chicago pierde la memoria y emprende un largo viaje.

programme.title: Seis Días Corrientes
programme.desc: Un peculiar equipo de tres manitas tiene que enfrentarse a una serie de excéntricos clientes.

programme.title: Lío en Broadway
programme.desc: Durante los ensayos de un nuevo proyecto teatral se forma un triángulo amoroso entre una esposa, una ex-amante, y una de las actrices.

programme.title: Devuélveme mi suerte
programme.desc: Ashley (Lindsay Lohan) es muy afortunada, tiene muy buena suerte y siempre le ha salido todo bien. Pero un día, Ashley besa a Jake (Chris Pine), el joven con peor suerte de la ciudad, y sus papeles se intercambian...

programme.title: Un padre de cuidado
programme.desc: Tim Allen es Joe, un chico cuya vida ha ido constantemente cambiando para peor. Cuando el acosador de la oficina va demasiado lejos, Joe decide que es hora volverse a sí mismo de un don nadie en un alguien.

programme.title: Entonces llegaste tú
programme.desc: Una viuda solitaria plantea realizar un viaje alrededor del mundo con las cenizas de su marido para visitar los sitios que ambos adoraban en sus películas favoritas.

programme.title: Pesadillas
programme.desc: Zach Cooper descubre el lado positivo de mudarse a un pueblo pequeño cuando conoce a su vecina Hannah, la hija de R. L. Stine, el célebre escritor de la serie Pesadillas. Stine es un hombre misterioso que vive prisionero de su propia imaginación, ya que los monstruos que sus libros hicieron famosos resultan ser reales y debe mantenerlos encerrados en sus manuscritos para proteger a sus lectores. Cuando los monstruos se liberan accidentalmente y comienzan a sembrar el terror en el pueblo, dependerá de Stine, Zach y Hannah hacer que regresen a los libros a los que pertenecen.

programme.title: Pesadillas 2: Noche De Halloween
programme.desc: ¡Ten mucho cuidado con lo que deseas! Sonny y Sam deciden trabajar después del colegio limpiando las casas de sus vecinos, esperando encontrar un tesoro entre los trastos de sus clientes. Sin embargo, ¡¡¡nunca pensaron que podrían encontrar algo así!!! Mientras limpian la antigua casa de Stine descubren un antiguo libro y liberan a la gran pesadilla ¡Slappy!. En una carrera contrarreloj y con la ayuda de Sarah, la hermana de Sonny, tendrán que encerrar de nuevo en el libro a todas las monstruosas criaturas que han vuelto a traer a la vida antes de que se desate el caos.

programme.title: ¡Vaya vacaciones!
programme.desc: Para compensar el poco tiempo que pasa con su mujer e hijos, Bob Munro les promete un viaje a Hawai. Pero, en el último momento, cambia de idea y decide hacer una ruta por Colorado en caravana. Durante el trayecto, lleno de contratiempos, conocerán a los Gornicke, una familia con la que entablarán amistad.

programme.title: Hook (El Capitán Garfio)
programme.desc: A pesar de ser un abogado de éxito profesional y de tener una encantadora familia, Peter Banning ha perdido algo maravilloso, su propia infancia. Cuando sus hijos son secuestrados por un antiguo enemigo y llevados al País de Nunca Jamás, el también tiene que viajar a ese reino encantado. Sólo de esa manera puede recuperar a los suyos y también al niño que un día fue. Allí vivirá emocionantes y divertidas aventuras.

programme.title: Rifles apaches
programme.desc: En 1879, el capitán Jeff Stanton debe devolver a los apaches mescaleros a su reserva. Captura al hijo del jefe para negociar la paz, pero mineros codiciosos sabotean la tregua. Stanton es reemplazado por un coronel implacable, provocando el caos. Entre traiciones y conflictos, la lucha por la justicia y la paz toma un giro peligroso.

programme.title: Ases y ochos
programme.desc: Los pacíficos colonos de un pueblo destinado a la grandeza del ferrocarril se arriesgan a establecerse en el inexplorado Oeste y, de repente, son asesinados a tiros sin piedad.

programme.title: Avanzada del Infierno
programme.desc: Un veterano de la guerra de Corea intenta ayudar al propietario de una mina de un pequeño pueblo, a desarrollar su mina de tungsteno a pesar de los esfuerzos del jefe del pueblo por detenerlo.

programme.title: Abriendo horizontes
programme.desc: Con la Guerra Civil a punto de comenzar, los saboteadores del Sur atacan la construcción del ferrocarril fronterizo.

programme.title: Cuatro pistoleros rápidos (Four Fast Guns)
programme.desc: Un pistolero llega a la ciudad de Purgatory afirmando ser el “pacificador” esperado, aunque oculta haber causado la muerte del hombre cuya misión ahora asume. A cambio de una recompensa, decide enfrentarse al jefe criminal local, un líder en silla de ruedas que envía a varios asesinos para eliminarlo.

programme.title: Evelyn
programme.desc: La esposa de Desmond lo abandona a él y a sus tres hijos después de la Navidad de 1953. Desempleado en Dublín, las autoridades colocan a los niños en orfanatos. Al volver a trabajar, Desmond intenta recuperar a sus hijos.

programme.title: Corazón de melón
programme.desc: Rosa, una mujer alegre con un don para la cocina, aprovecha un accidente que deja amnésico al chef Tomás para acercarse a él. Mientras la familia cree que son pareja, surge el amor verdadero entre recetas y ternura. Pero cuando la arrogante Fernanda descubre la verdad, la venganza amenaza con arruinarlo todo.

programme.title: En primera línea
programme.desc: Un equipo de bomberos del Ejército de Estados Unidos está fracturado por tensiones raciales, crisis morales y las presiones del combate en una guerra que nadie quiere pelear.

programme.title: Fast Track: Máxima velocidad
programme.desc: Danny Krueger, joven piloto callejero, gana una beca en Fast Lane Racing Academy. Tras un incidente que lo deja sin compañero, debe unir fuerzas con un antiguo rival para competir por un puesto en un equipo profesional, enfrentando tensión dentro y fuera de la pista.

programme.title: Jake
programme.desc: Una pareja casada, Alex y Greg, tiene que afrontar un conflicto cuando descubre que su hijo prefiere a la Cenicienta en lugar de los G.I. Joe.

programme.title: La abeja Maya. La película
programme.desc: La curiosa abeja Maya y su amigo Willy salvarán a la colmena de la avaricia del consejero de la reina y pondrán fin a años de hostilidad entre abejas y avispas. Maya es una abeja recién nacida muy vivaracha que no sigue las reglas de la colmena, entre ellas la de no confiar en las avispas que viven más allá de la pradera. Cuando desaparece la jalea real, las avispas son las principales sospechosas y las abejas señalan a Maya como cómplice del robo. Ninguna de sus compañeras cree en su inocencia y Willy, su mejor amigo, será su único apoyo. Juntos se embarcarán en un largo viaje lleno de aventuras hasta la colmena de las avispas para encontrar al verdadero culpable. Gracias a Maya y Willy por fin reinará la amistad entre todos los residentes de la opulenta pradera.

programme.title: Mi amigo Blue
programme.desc: Una icónica historia de amistad entre un muchacho y un perro único y desgarbado que se convertiría en una leyenda australiana.

programme.title: El proyecto Colibrí
programme.desc: Dos primos intentan hacerse millonarios mediante la construcción de un cable de fibra óptica entre Kansas y Nueva Jersey, mientras su antigua jefa intenta evitar que lo consigan

programme.title: El club de los incomprendidos
programme.desc: Valeria es una joven que se acaba de trasladar a Madrid. En su nuevo instituto, Valeria se ve obligada a asistir a unas reuniones con el orientador a las que también acuden otros compañeros de clase. Acaba de nacer EL CLUB DE LOS INCOMPRENDIDOS.

programme.title: Matria
programme.desc: Ramona vive en un pueblo de Galicia sumida en un contexto laboral y personal tenso e impredecible. Siempre sacrificándolo todo por el futuro de su hija Estrella, se verá empujada a mirar hacia dentro y a pensar que, tal vez, haya algo nuevo por lo que vivir.

programme.title: El apóstata
programme.desc: Premio FIPRESCI del Festival de San Sebastián 2015. "El apóstata" es una comedia dramática que repasa las cicatrices de un joven que desea emanciparse de aquello que se escapa de su control, a la vez que dispara contra sí mismo y con un afán cínico en algunas cuestiones de fe, de culpa y de deseo.

programme.title: Una película póstuma
programme.desc: Un hombre de ciudad recibe la llamada de la mujer a la que amó y emprende un viaje clandestino para reencontrarse con ella en una comunidad proscrita asentada en la cumbre de una montaña. Dos guías sucesivos le llevan a su destino: el reencuentro con una historia que no ha podido olvidar.

programme.title: Killbillies
programme.desc: Deformed, depraved hillbillies capture models and crew of a photo shoot. Will they all die a horrible death or fight off the attackers?

programme.title: Cuadecuc Vampir
programme.desc: An analysis of the construction mechanism for the magic in dominant narrative cinema though the filming of Nachts, wenn Dracula erwacht (1970), a commercial film by Jesus Franco.

programme.title: Beating Hearts
programme.desc: A harrowing take on family ties, true love and murder.

programme.title: 3 Hikers
programme.desc: 'The Three Hikers' tells the story of three Americans (Sarah Shourd, Shane Bauer and Josh Fattal) who went hiking in Northern Iraqi Kurdistan in July 2009, and were captured and held as political hostages by the Iranian Government for more than two years.

programme.title: Lejos del Fuego
programme.desc: Después de un año sin verse, Palo y sus amigas se reúnen en una casa en el campo para ponerse al día y, a ser posible, recuperar su amistad. Lejos de las diferen- cias que las distanciaron en el pasado. Lejos del caos de la ciudad. Lejos del fuego.

programme.title: Esto no es un atracto
programme.desc: Dos chicos de instituto que no consiguen ligar son víctimas de una broma de dos chicas.

programme.title: Asalto sin límite
programme.desc: Es una vida sucia y rentable de crimen para los ladrones de coches conocidos como «choppers». Se necesita velocidad, valor y saber hacer, pero si a eso le añadimos un asesinato y un policía encubierto, la cosa puede ponerse explosiva.

programme.title: Robot Apocalypse
programme.desc: Cuando la experta hacker Tara intenta detener a una poderosa inteligencia artificial que se apodera del ejército mundial, la inteligencia artificial la considera una terrorista que debe ser exterminada.

programme.title: Secuestrado en Rumanía
programme.desc: Dos periodistas italoamericanos han desaparecido mientras se encontraban en una misión en Rumanía.

programme.title: Vanguard
programme.desc: La compañía de seguridad encubierta Vanguard es la última esperanza de supervivencia para un contable que es perseguido por la organización de mercenarios más mortífera del mundo.

programme.title: Altitud
programme.desc: Una agente del FBI es castigada y enviada a un trabajo de administrativa en Washington DC después de desobedecer a sus mandos en una negociación con rehenes. En el avión que le lleva a Washington conoce a un apuesto hombre de negocios que le ofrece una recompensa si le ayuda a bajar del avión.

programme.title: Asia connection
programme.desc: Dos expatriados estadounidenses, Jack y Sam deciden robar un banco. Sin saberlo se han llevado el dinero de un poderoso narcotraficante.

programme.title: Blood Money
programme.desc: Un cártel de droga colombiano se alía con un grupo de Triads de Hong Kong y con el sicario más atactivo del planeta para enviar dos toneladas de cocaína a Australia y a China.

programme.title: Código de defensa
programme.desc: A un agente especial estadounidense caído en desgracia (John Cusack) se le encarga la rutinaria misión de proteger a una joven civil (Malin Akerman), cifradora de códigos de defensa, en una estación emisora secreta en Gran Bretaña.

programme.title: Geo-Disaster
programme.desc: Una familia se encuentra separada durante la convergencia de las mayores catástrofes de la historia.

programme.title: El ejecutor
programme.desc: Kyle fue criado por un corrupto sacerdote que lo entrenó para hacer el mal.

programme.title: Sharknado 5: Aletamiento Global
programme.desc: Con gran parte de América del Norte en ruinas, el resto del mundo se prepara para lo inevitable.

programme.title: Cold Cross
programme.desc: William busca vengar a sus padres, sin saber que también lo persiguen.

programme.title: The Legend Of Zorro
programme.desc: ¡El justiciero de la capa original ha regresado! Antonio Banderas y la ganadora del Oscar(r) Catherine Zeta-Jones (2002, mejor actriz de reparto, Chicago) vuelven con más duelos a espada, aventuras y emoción en el explosivo espectáculo cinematográfico, ¡THE LEGEND OF ZORRO! Tras pasar los últimos diez años luchando contra la injusticia y la crueldad, Alejandro de la Vega (Banderas) se enfrenta ahora a su mayor desafío: ¡su amada esposa Elena (Zeta-Jones) lo ha echado de casa! Elena ha pedido el divorcio y ha encontrado cobijo en los brazos del conde Armand (Rufus Sewell), un apuesto aristócrata francés. Pero Alejandro sabe algo que ella no sabe: Armand es el maligno cerebro de una trama terrorista para destruir Estados Unidos. Así, con su matrimonio y el futuro del país en juego, el Zorro debe salvar dos uniones antes de que sea demasiado tarde.

programme.title: The Mask Of Zorro
programme.desc: Cuando un déspota sediento de poder planea comprarle California a México, hacen falta dos Zorros - el legendario Don Diego de la Vega (Anthony Hopkins) y su sucesor elegido Alejandro Murrieta (Antonio Banderas), un gallardo bandido convertido en héroe - para frustrar los planes sin escrúpulos del tirano. ¿Pero bastará la combinación de sus habilidades, sus bravuconerías y proezas para lograr el objetivo final de De la Vega: vengarse del hombre que mató a su mujer, secuestró a su hija y lo tuvo prisionero durante veinte años?

programme.title: The Legend Of Zorro
programme.desc: ¡El justiciero de la capa original ha regresado! Antonio Banderas y la ganadora del Oscar(r) Catherine Zeta-Jones (2002, mejor actriz de reparto, Chicago) vuelven con más duelos a espada, aventuras y emoción en el explosivo espectáculo cinematográfico, ¡THE LEGEND OF ZORRO! Tras pasar los últimos diez años luchando contra la injusticia y la crueldad, Alejandro de la Vega (Banderas) se enfrenta ahora a su mayor desafío: ¡su amada esposa Elena (Zeta-Jones) lo ha echado de casa! Elena ha pedido el divorcio y ha encontrado cobijo en los brazos del conde Armand (Rufus Sewell), un apuesto aristócrata francés. Pero Alejandro sabe algo que ella no sabe: Armand es el maligno cerebro de una trama terrorista para destruir Estados Unidos. Así, con su matrimonio y el futuro del país en juego, el Zorro debe salvar dos uniones antes de que sea demasiado tarde.
